cards.name: Curse of Express Route
cards.text: Seekers can't disembark transport for 5 minutes.

cards.name: Curse of Menu
cards.text: Hider picks a drink from their bar menu (any branded alcohol). Seekers must find the same one and drink it before asking another question.

cards.name: Curse of Prison
cards.text: If seekers are in your chosen hiding bar when this is played, they are locked there for 10 minutes and draw a card. You must tell them they are at your bar.

cards.name: Curse of Pokies
cards.text: Seekers must find pokies and can't ask a question until they win.

cards.name: Curse of Clash
cards.text: Seekers can't use any transport until they beat the hiders at Clash Royale.

cards.name: Curse of Sculling
cards.text: Hiders get one chance to chug a schooner / pint and time it. Seekers can't use transport until they chug a schooner / pint quicker.

cards.name: Curse of Escape
cards.text: Seekers have 3 minutes to exit a bar. Any drinks ordered must be finished before they leave. If they don't leave in time, they are locked in the bar for 10 minutes.

cards.name: Curse of Impression
cards.text: Seekers spin the impression wheel and can't ask questions until a stranger guesses the character correctly.

cards.name: Curse of Hammered
cards.text: Seekers roll a die. The number is how many shots they must drink before asking another question. Shots can be shared across the team.

cards.name: Curse of Quan
cards.text: Seekers must lose at pool before asking their next question.

cards.name: Curse of Moll
cards.text: Seekers must correctly answer 3 Harry Potter trivia questions before their next question. No Google.

cards.name: Curse of Louis
cards.text: If someone on the seekers' team has said the n word in the last 30 minutes, all seekers drink.

cards.name: Curse of Adam
cards.text: Adam has to drink.

cards.name: Curse of Cruz
cards.text: Seekers must ask their next question from inside a KFC, or after eating something watermelon flavoured.

cards.name: Curse of Nathan
cards.text: Seekers must buy Nathan's next drink.
